criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: General COVID-19 Information
categories.definition: User seeks broad or introductory information about COVID-19.

categories.name: Symptoms Information
categories.definition: User asks about specific symptoms, signs, or what to worry about regarding COVID-19.

categories.name: Transmission Information
categories.definition: User inquires about how COVID-19 spreads between people, animals, or through various mediums.

categories.name: Prevention and Protection
categories.definition: User seeks advice or methods to avoid contracting or spreading COVID-19.

categories.name: Treatment and Cure Information
categories.definition: User asks about available treatments, remedies, vaccines, or the possibility of a cure for COVID-19.

categories.name: Statistics and Data
categories.definition: User requests numerical data related to COVID-19, such as case counts, death rates, recovery rates, or testing numbers.

categories.name: News and Updates
categories.definition: User asks for the latest information, recent developments, or current news articles about COVID-19 in general or specific locations.

categories.name: Travel Information and Restrictions
categories.definition: User inquires about travel safety, restrictions, cancellations, or advice related to COVID-19.

categories.name: COVID-19 Myths and Misinformation
categories.definition: User asks to confirm or debunk common myths, rumors, or false claims about COVID-19.

categories.name: Personal Risk and Guidance
categories.definition: User seeks advice on personal actions, risk assessment for themselves or family, or specific situations related to COVID-19 exposure or vulnerability.

categories.name: Object and Surface Contamination
categories.definition: User asks about the virus's presence, survival, or cleaning methods on objects, surfaces, or in specific environments.

categories.name: Animal and Pet Information
categories.definition: User inquires about COVID-19's impact on animals, pets, or transmission from animals.

categories.name: Food, Drink, and Hygiene Practices
categories.definition: User asks about safety related to food, drink, personal hygiene, or cleaning practices to prevent COVID-19.

categories.name: Donation and Support
categories.definition: User expresses intent to donate money, goods, or support to COVID-19 related causes, organizations, or individuals.

categories.name: Sharing Information/Service
categories.definition: User expresses intent to share the current information, service, or a link with others.

categories.name: Social Greetings and Gratitude
categories.definition: User expresses thanks, appreciation, or engages in social pleasantries with the bot.

categories.name: Expressing Fear or Anxiety
categories.definition: User explicitly states feelings of fear or anxiety related to COVID-19 and may seek reassurance or guidance.

categories.name: Operational Request
categories.definition: User makes a request to the bot that is not directly seeking COVID-19 information, but rather an action for the bot to perform.
